predecessors.name: Mecklenburg
predecessors.text: the Lordship of Stargard and the Principality of Ratzeburg, set apart as Mecklenburg-Strelitz in 1701

successors.name: German Empire
successors.text: the grand duchy, a state of the German Empire (1871-1918)

ledger.x: 1806: the map begins with the Duchy of Mecklenburg-Strelitz, set up as a duchy in its own right by the Treaty of Hamburg of 1701 ('Section 2 of the treaty established Mecklenburg-Strelitz as a duchy in its own right') with the Lordship of Stargard and the Principality of Ratzeburg; 1806 is the first year of the…
1815: the duchy becomes the Grand Duchy of Mecklenburg-Strelitz.
1871: Mecklenburg-Strelitz becomes a state of the German Empire.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: The duchy left the Confederation of the Rhine (1808-1813) and was an independent duchy 1813-1815 (Duchy page infobox).

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The grand duchy 'allied with Prussia in the Austro-Prussian War of 1866' and joined the North German Confederation; no land changed hands.

certainty.note: No page gives the boundary of the two detached parts.
A member of the German Confederation after the Congress of Vienna; the pages record no change of border.
